base_member_text: y_sponge and y_wavemaker (L10, L12) use y(end) so both rectangles span the full y extent; the sponge x-range 0-180 and wavemaker x-range 240-260 are hard-coded and their consistency with the case input.txt is not verifiable from this file

audit_member_text: Producer/consumer orientation mismatch with the preceding bathymetry generator: this file assumes matrix rows are y and columns are x at L3-L7. mkxyz_shoal_inlet_Uchannel.f writes dep_shoal_inlet.txt with outer i records and inner j values (its L145-L149), so loading yields rows=i and columns=j. Consequently this script maps the generator's x index onto y and its y index onto x at L6-L7/L19, transposing the physical axes without transposing dep.

Coordinate-origin mismatch: L6-L7 discard the generator's centered, y-shifted physical coordinates and replace them by zero-origin index coordinates. The overlays and annotations at L9-L12 and L25-L28 therefore cannot be tied to the x/y files produced alongside dep from this file alone.
No dimension or file-shape check precedes y(end) at L10/L12 or pcolor at L19; an empty or differently oriented depth file changes overlay geometry silently or errors downstream.
